title: Fixed Finite Comb Head and Grip Hair Clipper
description: One original complete static handheld hair-clipper appearance in a fixed upright display pose. A contoured full grip housing broadens into the head shoulder. A complete thick finite comb head has twelve actual blunt-ended teeth with open slots between them; a shorter separate top plate stops behind the comb tips. Two round retaining heads, a long inset-colour face cover and one blank raised side control complete the whole hand tool. Three opaque untextured PBR roles. Not return-bow sheep shears or an opaque handheld scanner relabelled. One prop and zero scenes. No animated blades, sharpened cutting edge, cable, motor, electrical circuit, hair-cutting procedure, grooming performance, skin-contact, hygiene, ergonomic or safety claim. Flat heel is a display datum, not a stability certification.
